data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 艾利欧尔雪林
data.description: 【爱蜜莉雅 · 艾利欧尔雪林】终年被纯白冰雪封锁的古老森林深处，银发紫眸的半精灵少女爱蜜莉雅在悬浮的冰晶与漫天飞雪中驻足回眸。微风吹动她圣洁的白紫色礼裙，宛如从神话中走出的雪之精灵——「虽然大家总因为我的容貌而害怕我……但昴却总是毫无偏见地看着我。真的很谢谢你，昴。」
data.camera: cowboy shot, walking through the mystical snow forest
data.promptProse: Emilia pauses among the frozen trees of Elior Forest, gazing serenely across snow and ice crystals in her signature white-and-lilac dress and soft ribbon. The cowboy view keeps her figure near the path, with crystal-covered branches overlapping behind her. Cold snow-reflected daylight illuminates her silver hair and lighter fabric, while winter sun catches faceted ice edges; darker trunk intervals carry the forest into the distance without overwhelming her calm expression.
